clue.text: As artist reflected, picturesque hint of colour gets erased

indicators.note: a reflection in a mirror shows things the wrong way round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is the standard crossword artist

indicators.note: something erased is rubbed out, so that letter is removed from the word

parts.note: a picturesque view is a scenic one
the first letter of colour

explanation.surface: A painter's scene loses its touch of colour, as the artist looks back on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As' looks like a mere joining word at the start, but it is the definition: As is the chemical symbol for ARSENIC. Remove C from SCENIC and put AR in front.
explanation.definitionFit: As is the symbol in the periodic table for the element arsenic, a crossword-only abbreviation sense.

clue.text: Process nearly all of tropical fruit

indicators.note: nearly all means everything except the final letter of the word that follows
to process material is to work it over into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the word tropical with its last letter dropped

explanation.surface: An instruction to put most of a tropical fruit through a machine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tropical fruit' reads as a single phrase, but tropical is the anagram fodder and fruit alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An apricot is a stone fruit, an example of the general category named.

clue.text: Old golfer has inflamed cut

parts.note: Seve Ballesteros, the late Spanish golfing champion
inflamed skin is red

explanation.surface: A veteran golfer is nursing a sore wound.
explanation.definitionFit: Severed means cut through or sliced off, a straightforward synonym for the past participle.

clue.text: Keep fish for matron

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to keep and cherish, as with a grudge or a drink
second meaning: a kind of shark found in warm shallow waters
third meaning: the senior woman in charge of a hospital ward

explanation.surface: Someone is told to set aside some fish for the hospital matron.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a triple definition: three separate senses of one word, with 'for' merely joining them.
explanation.definitionFit: To nurse a grudge is to keep it; the nurse shark is a fish; a matron is a senior hospital sister.

clue.text: Acting with caution over thief?

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: taking care is being cautious
a thief is one who takes; the question mark flags the loose sense

explanation.surface: Someone performing warily in front of a burglar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Acting' suggests the stage, but here it is the adjective for someone filling in temporarily, as in a caretaker manager.
explanation.definitionFit: A caretaker government or manager holds office temporarily, which is what an acting head does.

clue.text: In York the minister drops off publicity for dean?

parts.note: in Yorkshire dialect 'the' is shortened to t'

indicators.note: dropping something off means leaving it behind, so those letters are removed

parts.note: a minister of religion preaches
PR stands for public relations, publicity work

explanation.surface: A cathedral clergyman at York shuns publicity, as a dean might.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface points at York Minster and a cathedral dean, but the dean is a university one, and 'the' in Yorkshire speech is t'.
explanation.definitionFit: A dean is a senior academic in a college faculty, so is an example of a teacher, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Governess could be one changing the heart of Henry VIII?

indicators.note: changing the heart means swapping the central letter of the name for another

parts.note: Henry VIII belonged to the Tudor royal house

explanation.surface: A governess who might have changed the king's heart, Henry VIII being famously fickle.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the middle D of TUDOR for a T. The clue reads as wordplay plus the hint that the answer is 'one changing' it.
explanation.definitionFit: A governess is a private teacher in a household, just as a private tutor is.

clue.text: Young prince defends time with court designer

indicators.note: to defend something is to stand guard around it, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: Prince Archie is the young son of Prince Harry
T is the abbreviation for time
CT is the abbreviation for court

explanation.surface: A royal youngster stands up for himself in court, joined by a designer.
explanation.definitionFit: An architect is the person who designs buildings.

clue.text: Object of a burning passion?

parts.note: surface reading: the person someone is wildly in love with
setter's reading: an engagement with someone who is attractive, a romantic evening that is sizzling

explanation.walkthrough: The burning passion is the heat of a romantic evening out; the object of it is a date who is literally called hot.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot date is an exciting romantic appointment with an attractive partner, the focus of ardent feeling.

clue.text: Ethiopian royal lady's showing items which may be smoked

parts.note: Ras is an Ethiopian title for a prince or ruler
belonging to a lady is hers

explanation.surface: An Ethiopian princess displays things that might be smoked, perhaps pipes or cigars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smoked' suggests tobacco, but it is bacon being cured by smoke.
explanation.definitionFit: Rashers are slices of bacon, which is often sold smoked or unsmoked.

clue.text: Kings and queen entertaining first lady worshipper

indicators.note: to entertain guests is to have them inside your home, so one piece goes within another

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for king (Rex), doubled for the plural
Eve was the first woman in Genesis
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is a standard crossword queen

explanation.surface: Royalty play host to the First Lady, who is a devoted admirer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First lady' suggests a President's wife, but it is Eve; she sits between the two Rs, before ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverer is one who reveres, that is, holds someone in deep religious respect.

clue.text: Old historian has book about origins of Anglican Church

indicators.note: about here means going around, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: Titus is a book of the New Testament

indicators.note: the origins of words are where they start, so only their initial letters are used

parts.note: the opening letters of these two words

explanation.surface: An ancient historian owns a book on the beginnings of the Church of England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book' could be B or VOL, but here it is a named book of the Bible, which the abbreviation sits inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacitus was a Roman writer of the first century whose Annals and Histories chronicle the early empire.

clue.text: Maybe Karen has quibble with record

parts.note: to carp is to quibble or nitpick
to enter data is to record it

explanation.surface: A woman named Karen objects to something on a record, a nod to the familiar complaining Karen.
explanation.walkthrough: Karen Carpenter was the singer and drummer of the 1970s duo the Carpenters; 'record' sounds musical but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Karen is an example of a Carpenter, the famous American pop singer, hence 'Maybe'.

clue.text: Maxim a gentleman holds still?

indicators.note: the phrase holds the answer within it, spanning its word boundaries

parts.note: the letters run across the end of the first word, the a, and the start of the third

explanation.surface: A proverb says a gentleman keeps calm and holds still.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Still' looks like an adverb ending the sentence, but it is a noun: a single photograph from a film.
explanation.definitionFit: A still is a photograph, a single frame taken from a movie, so a type of picture.

clue.text: Note pulse going up and down, maybe

parts.note: ti is the seventh note of the tonic sol-fa scale
dal is lentils or split peas, an edible pulse

explanation.surface: A medical note records a pulse that keeps rising and falling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pulse' suggests a heartbeat, but it is the vegetable sense: dal, the lentil dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Tidal water rises and falls with the tides, so going up and down is one example of the adjective.

clue.text: Star sign finally shared with heretic bookkeeper

indicators.note: the closing letter is shared, so it is written once where the two words overlap

parts.note: Libra, the scales, is a sign of the zodiac
an Arian follows Arius, whose views on the Trinity were declared heresy

explanation.surface: Someone's star sign turns out to be shared with a heretic who keeps the accounts.
explanation.walkthrough: The A ending the star sign also starts the heretic, so the two words overlap on that letter. 'Bookkeeper' suggests an accountant but is read literally.
explanation.definitionFit: A librarian looks after the books in a library, so is literally a keeper of books.

clue.text: Greek seeds cut and diced in rice dishes

indicators.note: a word that is cut is trimmed short, losing its last letter
dicing chops food into pieces, so the letters are chopped and mixed

parts.note: taken as written
seeds with its last letter removed

explanation.surface: A recipe in which Greek seeds are chopped and diced into rice dishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Kedgeree is a dish of rice, flaked smoked fish and egg, a British breakfast of Anglo-Indian origin.

clue.text: Daughter always rests in mornings

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter
ay (or aye) is an old word for always, ever
a break is a rest

explanation.surface: A daughter who always lies in during the mornings.
explanation.definitionFit: Daybreak is dawn, the start of the morning; the plural matches mornings.

clue.text: Weep over unusually barren fruit shrub

indicators.note: over here means draped across and around, so one word encloses the other

parts.note: to weep is to cry

indicators.note: something done unusually departs from its normal order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A gardener sobs over a fruit bush that has failed to crop.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters sit between the R and Y of CRY.
explanation.definitionFit: The cranberry is a low evergreen shrub of bogs bearing tart red berries.

clue.text: Church Times ordered for scientist

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for church

indicators.note: the letters are put in order, that is, sorted into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone has ordered a copy of the Church Times, an Anglican weekly newspaper, for a scientist.
explanation.walkthrough: The Church Times is a real British newspaper, which makes 'ordered' look like a newsagent's order.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemist is a scientist who studies chemistry.

clue.text: One who has opening words in pantomime?

definitions.text: One who has opening words in pantomime?

parts.note: surface reading: the first lines spoken at the start of a show

parts.words: One who has opening words in pantomime?
parts.note: setter's reading: the panto hero whose magic words, open sesame, open the robbers' cave

explanation.walkthrough: A pantomime is a British Christmas family stage show based on a fairy tale; this hero's tale is a favourite, and his password opens a door rather than the play.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Arabian Nights tale he says 'open sesame' to make the cave of the forty thieves open.

clue.text: Run over energy deal

indicators.note: turned over means flipped, so the word is read back to front

parts.note: to dart is to run quickly
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A sprint carried out on energy, perhaps a rundown of a power deal.
explanation.definitionFit: To trade is to deal in goods, buying and selling them as business.

clue.text: Sharon Stone possibly about to cut a bit of hair

indicators.note: a piece that cuts into another sits within it, splitting it in two

parts.note: taken as written
C is short for circa, Latin for about
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: The Hollywood star Sharon Stone is about to get a trim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About to' reads as 'on the point of', but about is C and 'to cut' tells it to go inside A TRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharon Stone is a Hollywood film star, an example of the profession, hence 'possibly'.

clue.text: Sweet Penny lost an item of jewellery

indicators.note: something lost has gone missing, so that letter is taken away

parts.note: a pear drop is a boiled sweet flavoured like pear
P is the abbreviation for a penny

explanation.surface: Sweet Penny has mislaid one of her earrings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweet Penny' reads as an affectionate name, but sweet is a noun: a pear drop, a British boiled sweet, from which P goes.
explanation.definitionFit: An eardrop is a pendant earring, an ornament that hangs from the ear.

clue.text: At first English rose is called after another plant

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter of each following word

parts.note: the initial letters of these five words

explanation.surface: An English rose variety is named in honour of a different plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another' is fair because a rose has just been mentioned: the answer is a different plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is the genus of heaths and heathers, low flowering shrubs.

clue.text: One briefed to stop run by nun starting late

indicators.note: starting late means missing the beginning, so the opening letter is dropped
by means next to, so the pieces sit side by side

parts.note: to bar is to stop or prevent
R is the cricket abbreviation for a run
a nun is a sister

explanation.surface: Someone is told to block a nun who set off late on her run.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a barrister is the courtroom lawyer who receives a brief, the case papers, from a solicitor.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrister is instructed by being given a brief, so is someone briefed in the legal sense.

clue.text: Person acquiring farm building on the phone

indicators.note: a voice on the phone is heard, not seen, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: a byre is a cowshed

explanation.surface: Someone calling about purchasing a farm building.
explanation.definitionFit: A buyer is a purchaser, someone who obtains goods by paying.

clue.text: Livid form of light above mischievous goddess

indicators.note: in a down clue, above means the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: IR is infrared, a form of light beyond the visible
Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and folly

explanation.surface: A goddess bent on mischief, shown in a lurid light.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Livid' also means bluish-grey or pale, matching the light imagery, but here it means furious.
explanation.definitionFit: Livid in the informal sense is very angry, as is someone irate.

clue.text: Worthless quality of unknown metal auntie oddly rejected

indicators.note: something rejected is sent back, so the whole string is turned round

parts.note: Y is a mathematical unknown
tin is a metal

indicators.note: oddly picks out the letters in odd positions, first, third and fifth

parts.note: letters one, three and five of auntie

explanation.surface: Auntie turns down some metal of uncertain value as worthless.
explanation.definitionFit: Inanity is emptiness or silliness, the quality of being pointless or lacking any value.

clue.text: A mother houses United enthusiast

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: to house something is to give it room inside, so one piece goes within another

parts.note: mater is Latin for mother, used in old public-school slang
U is the abbreviation for United in football team names

explanation.surface: A mother takes in a fan of Manchester United, or some other United.
explanation.walkthrough: U goes between the E and R of MATER.
explanation.definitionFit: An amateur is someone who pursues an activity for love rather than money, hence an enthusiast.

clue.text: Head-scratching riddle — either way the answer is 5

indicators.note: scratching out the head means striking off the first letter

parts.note: a riddle is a coarse sieve, as for soil

explanation.surface: A puzzling riddle that leaves you scratching your head, whose answer is the same either way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head-scratching riddle' suggests a puzzle, but riddle is the gardener's sieve losing its S. The 5 refers to 5 Across, TEACHER.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainer instructs people in a skill, which is what a teacher does.

clue.text: Accepts responsibility for increases

definitions.meaning: first meaning: comes forward to take on a duty
second meaning: raises in stages, as with production

explanation.walkthrough: Both senses come from the image of climbing a stair.
explanation.definitionFit: To come forward and volunteer for a task, or to raise something gradually, are both senses of the phrasal verb.
